_doc: Per-platform posting config for the auto-poster (see PRD: Auto-Post Approved Ads). Keys match config/ad-platforms.json. Only enabled platforms are posted to; the rest stay manual in v1. login_url is where capture-login opens a headed browser for the operator to sign in; new_listing_url is where the posting script starts the listing form. URLs for disabled platforms are best-effort placeholders — verify against the live site before enabling. Saved sessions live in workers/posting/auth/<platform>.json (secrets — never expose via the files API or logs).
